title: Single root cover splits invertible-order torsors near a regular divisor
statement: Let i:U→L be a morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], G a finite group, and W→U a finite etale G-torsor [def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois]. Let R be a commutative regular ring [def-weil-regular-scheme], φ:Spec R→L, and f∈R a nonzerodivisor with regular quotient R/(f). Suppose |G| is a unit in R. Let β:U×_L Spec R≅D(f) [def-pc-fibre-product] commute with the projections to Spec R. For every y∈Spec R there exist a commutative ring S, a ring map a:R→S, and z∈Spec S such that ψ=Spec(a) is etale and ψ(z)=y. Put g=a(f). There is a positive integer n that is a unit in S, with S and S/(g) regular and g a nonzerodivisor. Put A=S[T]/(T^n-g), N=Spec A, q:N→Spec S its structure map, V=D(g)⊂N, and p:W×_L Spec S→Spec S the projection (using W→L and ψ;φ). There exist d≥0 and an isomorphism δ:(W×_L Spec S)×_{Spec S}V≅⨿_{Fin d}V over V: δ followed by the fold map to V equals the second projection. All rings and schemes are in universe u and G in u+1. This is a splitting by one root extension; no classification into different root exponents is asserted.

proof.text: Choose Ω as the algebraic closure of the residue field at y, and take barY to be its spectrum map followed by fromSpecResidueField y. This geometric point has image y. Use full faithfulness of Spec to recover the unique ring map b:R→H inducing the canonical strict-henselization structural morphism.

Apply the strict-henselization root-section theorem with n=Nat.card G. Apply the section-descent theorem to π=W.π to obtain S,a,z and a section on its punctured root cover. Prove regularity of S directly by IsRegularLocalRing.localization_of_etale and Noetherianity of a finite-type algebra. Flatness proves g regular using hf.of_flat. Identify S/(g) with (R/(f)) tensor_R S by quotIdealMapEquivQuotTensor and apply the same etale regularity argument over R/(f). These are fully proved in the private helper regular_divisor_properties_of_etale. Positivity is Nat.card_pos because a group is nonempty; invertibility in S follows directly by applying a to hG.

The map pullback.snd i φ is monic because hβ identifies it with beta followed by the basic-open inclusion. Pullback.lift and cancellation against this monomorphism identify the ambient pullback of W.π;i along the punctured root structure map with the pullback of W.π along the section followed by W.π. This comparison is an explicitly constructed isomorphism with its projection equation proved by pullback.hom_ext.

Reindex the defining torsor coproduct from G to Fin(Nat.card G) and swap the pullback factors. The resulting map has components (identity,smul g). Apply the already proved library lemma CategoryTheory.FinitaryPreExtensive.isIso_sigmaDesc_lift_comp to the section. Invert this isomorphism; Sigma.hom_ext and the pullback projection identities show that its composite with the fold map is the second projection. Finally use pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso and pullback.congrHom to compare the iterated pullback in the statement with the ambient pullback, and compose the isomorphisms. All these categorical steps are fully proved in the item, with no new hole.

proof_origin.place: Tags 09EB, 0BRM, 0EYE, 0EYG, 0BSK and 05N9; P4 factors the geometric proof into strict-hensel root section and pointed etale section descent, and proves the complete torsor trivialization and iterated-pullback assembly in Lean. The regular base, regular divisor quotient and nonzerodivisor ascent are also proved directly, not included in either new hole.

lean.statement:
theorem GaloisCover.regular_divisor_root_splitting
    {L U : Scheme.{u}} (i : U ⟶ L)
    (G : Type (u + 1)) [Group G] [Finite G] (W : GaloisCover G U)
    (R : CommRingCat.{u}) (φ : Spec R ⟶ L) (f : R)
    (hG : IsUnit (Nat.card G : R))
    [IsRegularRing R] (hf : IsSMulRegular R f)
    [IsRegularRing (R ⧸ Ideal.span {f})]
    (β : pullback i φ ≅ Scheme.Opens.toScheme (X := Spec R) (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f))
    (hβ : β.hom ≫ Scheme.Opens.ι (X := Spec R) (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen f) = pullback.snd i φ)
    (y : Spec R) :
    ∃ (S : CommRingCat.{u}) (a : R ⟶ S) (z : Spec S),
      Etale (Spec.map a) ∧ (Spec.map a) z = y ∧
      let g := a.hom f
      ∃ (n : ℕ),
        (0 < n ∧ IsUnit (n : S)) ∧
        IsRegularRing S ∧ IsSMulRegular S g ∧
        IsRegularRing (S ⧸ Ideal.span {g}) ∧
        let p := pullback.snd (W.π ≫ i) (Spec.map a ≫ φ)
        let A := AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial S) ^ n - Polynomial.C g)
        let N := Spec (CommRingCat.of A)
        let q := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap S A))
        let V : N.Opens := PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen (algebraMap S A g)
        ∃ (d : ℕ) (δ : pullback p (V.ι ≫ q) ≅ ∐ fun _ : Fin d ↦ V.toScheme),
          δ.hom ≫ Sigma.desc (fun _ : Fin d ↦ 𝟙 V.toScheme) =
            pullback.snd p (V.ι ≫ q)
